problem.passage:
A rectangular prism has length 9, width 5, and height 7, as shown in the figure.

What is the volume of the rectangular prism shown?
problem.stimulus: A rectangular prism has length 9, width 5, and height 7, as shown in the figure.
problem.question: What is the volume of the rectangular prism shown?
problem.explanationEn: The volume of a rectangular prism is length × width × height, so 9 × 5 × 7 = 315.
